title: Vehicle Terrain Sensor
text: Vehicle and tire distances to objects, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Tag for actor in 3D scene, ActorTag} sets the name SimulinVehicle1, {Distance to vehicle center} sets the selection, {Distance to tire center} sets the selection, {Distance from vehicle center to front, VehCntrLngthVal} sets the vehicle center, {Distance from tire center to ground, TireRadiiVal} sets the tire radii, {Vehicle body x-axis trace length, VehRayLngth} sets the trace length, {Left front wheel z-axis trace length, LfRayLngth} sets the trace length, {Right front wheel z-axis trace length, RfRayLngth} sets the trace length, {Left rear wheel z-axis trace length, LrRayLngth} sets the trace length, {Right rear wheel z-axis trace length, RrRayLngth} sets the trace length, {Vehicle body x-axis trace offset, VehRayOffset} sets the offset the vehicle ray trace, {Left front wheel z-axis trace offset, LfRayOffset} sets the offset the left front wheel ray trace, {Right front wheel z-axis trace offset, RfRayOffset} sets the offset the right front wheel ray trace, {Left rear wheel z-axis trace offset, LrRayOffset} sets the offset the left rear wheel ray trace, {Right rear wheel z-axis trace offset, RrRayOffset} sets the offset the right rear wheel ray trace, {Vehicle body} enables vehicle body ray tracing, {Left front tire} enables left front tire ray tracing, {Right front tire} enables right front tire ray tracing, {Left rear tire} enables left rear tire ray tracing, {Right rear tire} enables right rear tire ray tracing, {Trace line visualization} sets the visualize ray traces and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.
